name: Command R+

lifecycle.note: Applies to the hosted API ids command-r-plus-04-2024 and alias command-r-plus. The open weights (c4ai-command-r-plus) can still be downloaded from Hugging Face.

deprecated.note: Deprecated for new customers; existing users keep access until a shutdown date, which Cohere had not set as of 2026-10-01. The changelog announcement page is dated 2025-09-16.

relations.note: Editorial link along the line of Cohere's most capable Command model: Command R+ is the larger tier of the R series and was presented as Cohere's most powerful model, after the original Command. Cohere names no predecessor; the launch post says it builds on the strengths of Command R, which remains a separate tier.

summary.text: Command R+ is a text-only language model in Cohere's R series for enterprise use, launched on 4 April 2024 on Microsoft Azure and the Cohere API as the larger companion to Command R. It shares the 128k-token context, RAG with citations and 10-language focus, adds multi-step tool use, and has 104-billion-parameter research weights; the hosted model was deprecated on 15 September 2025.

changes.text: Adds multi-step tool use: the model combines several tools over several steps and can retry after a failed tool call.
104 billion parameters; the model card calls Command R its smaller companion model.
Higher API list price than Command R: 3.00 USD input and 15.00 USD output per million tokens, against 0.50 and 1.50 USD.
Launched first on Microsoft Azure, as part of a new collaboration, alongside the Cohere API.

openWeights.note: Open weights research release under CC-BY-NC 4.0.

sources.locator: Automating Complex Business Workflows With Tool Use

features.note: Multi-step tool use, new with this model.

sources.locator: Multilingual Support for Global Business Operations
Using Command Models on Different Platforms

access.note: Available first on Microsoft Azure and on the Cohere API from launch day, with Oracle OCI and other clouds announced to follow. Amazon Bedrock id cohere.command-r-plus-v1:0 per the platform table.

notes: Release date from the launch blog post (Apr 04, 2024). A docs changelog entry announcing Command R+ (https://docs.cohere.com/changelog/command-r-is-a-scalable-llm-for-business) shows January 17, 2023, which predates Command R and is evidently a dating error; it is not cited. The Hugging Face repository was created on 2024-04-03, probably private before launch. API id command-r-plus-04-2024 with alias command-r-plus. Lifecycle follows the deprecations page; the weights stay downloadable on Hugging Face. The deprecation notice recommends command-r-08-2024, command-r-plus-08-2024 or command-a-03-2025 without pairing them, so replacedBy is left out.
